title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 165  An Act Converting the Lolomboy Barangay High School in the Municipality of Bocaue, Province of Bulacan, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Lolomboy National High School.
title.orig: Batas Pambansa Blg. 165  An Act Converting the Lolomboy Barangay High School in the Municipality of Bocaue, Province of Bulacan, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Lolomboy National High School.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Lolomboy Barangay tại Thị trấn Bocaue, Tỉnh Bulacan thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Lolomboy Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lolomboy Barangay ในเทศบาล Bocaue จังหวัด Bulacan เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lolomboy แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Lolomboy Barangay di Kotamadya Bocaue, Provinsi Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lolomboy Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Lolomboy Barangay di Perbandaran Bocaue, Wilayah Bulacan kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lolomboy Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Lolomboy Barangay High School in Barangay Lolomboy, Municipality of Bocaue, Province
of Bulacan, is hereby converted into a national high school to be known as the Lolomboy National High

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operations and maintenance shall
be provided for in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
